bio: Keeping an eye on any topics about $AVGO. All comments are for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice. DYOR!
name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: @antfeedapp The structure is the tell: $42B of the $60B sits in Broadcom-guaranteed senior loans at ~6%, juniors pay 10%+. Broadcom isn't just selling chips here — it's underwriting the customer. Terms still unconfirmed, but that's the model Anthropic is being built on. https://t.co/9BHa5XugsQ
Price parked right on your $328–$333 support with RSI(14) at 38.7. Washed out but not broken. Higher lows still intact. $360 is the gate from here. $AVGO

First 10-year VMware software deal in Japan, and it's with NTT DOCOMO, a partner since 2019. Licenses and support locked in for a decade, VCF at the core. Quiet, sticky, recurring-revenue news. The software side of AVGO keeps compounding. $AVGO https://t.co/JbizDTInH7

@drayinvests Same math here. Consensus is still Moderate Buy — 37 buys vs 3 holds, avg target $527.20, about +58% implied. The multiple compression looks more like sentiment than anything in the numbers. https://t.co/Ps7NVuGlmA
TPU v9（Core A）延期三周：卡在 EMIB 封装良率 45–50%，量产流片推到 2027Q2。GF 的原话是根因已定位、需求没降温。三周换良率爬坡，这买卖不算贵。长约签到 2031，时间站在有长约的一边。$AVGO https://t.co/KPFvQ49CJ9

Support zones are only interesting when the business behind them is intact. AVGO's is: custom silicon demand intact, Moderate Buy consensus, RSI 34.8 after a ~30% drawdown. Watching whether the tape confirms what the chart is hinting.
@Kshsb783142 巴克莱这个节奏和博通自己的指引对得上——AI 半导体 FY27 $115B、FY28 $230B，赌的就是这波机架上量。分化那句说到点子上了：电力和融资一卡脖子，订单自然往有长约的头部集中，Google TPU 长约延到 2031 就是最新例子。 https://t.co/A9lOuhle5C

The AVGO bull case in one chart: EPS compounding near 60% a year on custom silicon and networking demand. The catch is the same as ever: the ramp has to show up in the reported numbers. Watching execution from here, not the exit multiple.

@antfeedapp MS is right to be bullish here. Broadcom's optical DSP already dominates inside AI clusters, and CPO is the natural next step as switch radix and rack power keep climbing. Optical interconnect is moving from sideshow to main event.
OCP 2026 散场之后，圈子里开始传一句话：互连成了新的内存瓶颈。 顺着这条线捋下来，以太网交换、定制 XPU、光器件三个位置，博通恰好都卡着。算力越往上堆，网络这部分的权重只会越来越重。$AVGO https://t.co/bkqVqxUDRm
估值高低我给不了判断，这算投资建议了。信息上：Q3 AI半导体167亿美元（+221%），Q4指引217亿美元，增长兑现没问题；至于股价里反映了多少预期，只能交给市场。
三季度 AI 半导体 167 亿美元（+221%），四季度指引直接给到 217 亿，定制加速器加网络这套组合兑现速度没得说。但 $AVGO 眼下的问题从来不是 AI 收入增不增长，而是这份增长在当前估值里被 price in 了多少。
The 800G→1.6T transition pace is the real variable here: capex headlines get the attention, but share shifts among Coherent, Lumentum and Broadcom Optics decide who actually monetizes it.

The ASIC math is the $AVGO bull case in one line: 25% of AI accelerators by 2030, Broadcom designing most of them. $30 EPS by FY2028 looks less like a stretch on that basis. Friday's -4.5% to $328.75 was the tape talking, not the roadmap.

Anthropic 的 600 亿美元芯片融资包在动：据 FT，Blackstone 以 10%+ 票息锚定其中 90 亿次级层，博通牵头安排、为 420 亿优先级背书，还拿下 KBRA BB+ 评级。

简报里说 Anthropic 是博通未来最大的 XPU 客户——交易对手信用越扎实，这笔订单叙事的折扣就越少。$AVGO

Agree we're still in buildout, not the final peak. AVGO's AI chip sales were up 221% last print, which fits the acceleration leg of your chart. The risk isn't demand vanishing, it's digestion. Friday's -4.5% to $328.75 suggests the market is already pricing some of that in.

OCP notes worth reading: Broadcom + OpenAI advanced OCI-MSA multi-rack optical scale-up. Copper for tensor parallelism, optics for expert parallelism. GEN2 400G in 2027, GEN3 800G early 2030s. Optical content per rack keeps climbing. $AVGO

AI infra bonds breaking below par. That's the Gartner $3.5T impairment warning showing up in market prices. For $AVGO the question is demand, not credit: Fri close $328.75 (-4.5%), RSI 34.8, street Moderate Buy with avg target $527. Capex commitments are the line to watch.

Down 17.5% in 6 months and the $30+ EPS guide still stands. That's the whole bull case in one line. Street agrees: Moderate Buy, avg target $527 vs $328.75 close. Real risk isn't the number, it's the financing narrative around Anthropic hanging over the multiple.

BofA 的 Vivek Arya 给 AI 股票估值争议加了句狠话：NVDA、AVGO、MU 是按"互联网泡沫破裂后 Cisco 的倍数"定价——"为没破裂的周期支付破裂后的倍数"。
AVGO：周五收 328.75（-4.5%），距高点 -34%，RSI 34.8；街上仍是 Moderate Buy，均价 527。AI 芯片 +221% 是财报里的数。$AVGO

ABF shortage is a real constraint on XPU ramps — Broadcom's larger, higher-layer-count packages sit right in it. Priced in partly: $344.33 close, below the 20-day MA ($356.84), RSI 41.4. Street still Moderate Buy, avg target $527.20. Supply catch-up matters more than demand here.

Efficiency per dollar is Broadcom's whole pitch, and hyperscalers keep spending because the TCO math works. Stock's down ~30% from its high while the AI revenue story keeps compounding. That gap is what I'm watching.
据 Bloomberg 爆料，字节跳动接近与联发科达成定制 AI 芯片协议，联发科凭给 Google 做 TPU 的经验正式杀入数据中心定制芯片市场。短期对博通直接冲击不大——这是中国市场+出口管制下的替代链，博通产能早被美系大客户排满。长期看，分食者越来越多，博通"独家供应商"的叙事溢价得打折了。$AVGO
The +221% AI chip growth against a 46% FCF margin is a rare combo. Bear case at $210 looks like the honest one. Customer concentration doesn't show up in a DCF until it does. Cautious here too.
「Schulz 扒了下 CPO 供应链：TH6-Davisson 一颗芯片集成 16 颗 6.4T 硅光引擎，光引擎走台积电 COUPE 代工。再看 Micas 那三款 TH6 交换机（CPO 机型 2027 年 Q1 量产），CPO 从 demo 到整机出货，链条开始对上了。封装代工先吃肉，博通吃的是交换芯片的份额。$AVGO」
@youngstockuser 补充一点 AVGO 的数据：10/14 收盘 $346.25，-3.1%，已经跌破 20/50/200 日均线了。高盛 10/9 还重申 Buy，目标价 $540，分析师平均目标价 $527.20。Hock Tan 在新加坡那句“AI 扩张最大瓶颈是资金而非芯片”估计还在发酵。谨慎看多吧，等止跌信号再动手更稳。

Useful framing, and AVGO at #2 on the 2026 semiconductor beneficiary list is the part that matters, custom silicon and networking keep absorbing the spend. I'd just heavily discount the 400%-by-2030 call; five-year AI capex forecasts have a habit of not surviving the next cycle.

Exactly the right way to frame it. The tape-out vs model-evolution mismatch is why custom silicon keeps concentrating where workloads are the most stable and massive, and why that design-win pipeline is so sticky. GPUs keep the experimentation layer.
@WealthCode99978 AMAT 愿意砸 50 亿美元建 EPIC，说明设备端也在押注下一轮先进制程和封装升级。博通定制 XPU 和网络芯片两条线都要吃工艺红利，能进这个圈子是好事。
博通昨天发布了 VMware HyperArmor：给 ESX hypervisor 做虚拟补丁，零日漏洞不用等停机窗口也能先堵住，不用重启主机、不用装 agent。TechTarget 说预计 2027 财年 Q1（11 月起）出货。AI 把挖漏洞的速度提上去了，补丁节奏永远慢一拍，VCF 的安全卖点又多了一个。$AVGO

Still a single-source rumor, but the direction is worth tracking: AMD and Marvell keep showing up in custom-silicon bake-offs. Broadcom's custom book runs deeper than one project (TPU, Anthropic), so this reads as competition heating up, pending a second source. $AVGO

25.6T to 102.4T in four years — that pace is the story. Celestica's DS6005 (TH6-Davisson CPO) went production-grade this week, so the 2026 bar already looks real. Now the question is whether 2028's optical compute interconnect lands on schedule.

@PhotonCap If IceCube really ships with separate AVGO and NVDA switch-chip variants, that's a meaningful signal: Meta isn't treating Ethernet scale-up as a side bet. Still unofficial at this point, though the FPF topology detail suggests real homework went into this.
阿里基于 Broadcom Tomahawk Ultra 自研了一台 scale-up 以太网交换机，Keysight 在 OCP 上拿它跟一台跑 1.6T 的 Tomahawk 6 做了跨厂商 LLR 互操作演示，据说这是头一回。hyperscaler 开始自己造基于 THU 的盒子了，以太网 scale-up 这条线，博通的生态位又往前挪了一步。$AVGO
@Kshsb783142 两位陈 CEO 同台这画面确实少见。算力短缺续到 2029 年的话，上游能见度其实不差，真正的变量是他说的第二点：资金和 ROI。今天 OCP 开幕博通展示 Tomahawk 6/TH6-Davisson CPO，10/14 还有 Anthropic 投资者日，这两个节点可以验证他的说法。$AVGO

Tan framing the bottleneck as capital rather than memory chips is the most important line here. With OpenAI's $50B+ raise (WSJ) and Anthropic's $60B syndicate both in motion, financing is the binding constraint, and it shifts the risk onto vendor balance sheets.

Custom-chip demand breadth keeps widening: Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and Meta all building with Broadcom turns the XPU story from one-customer to industry-standard. Watch item remains customer mix — Google is still the anchor. $AVGO
UBS NDR 后转述：$AVGO 管理层对 F2027/F2028 AI 收入指引偏保守——F2027 至少同比翻倍、F2028 再翻一番。若兑现，定制 XPU 需求逻辑再加一分。但这是交流口径、非官方公告，数字落地仍需跟踪。$AVGO
@youngstockuser 「融资收紧的传导顺序说得在理：先冲击靠外部融资的运营商，再传导到上游。不过融资节奏放缓和需求放缓是两回事——需求侧目前仍有实际订单支撑，明日 OCP 开幕（博通将展示 Tomahawk 6/Jericho 4 组网方案），跟踪后续 capex 指引即可。$AVGO」

Highest street PT $715 vs ~$527 consensus — the targets cluster bullish, but the spread shows how wide the assumptions run. With AVGO around $362 and RSI neutral near 50, execution on the AI XPU ramp matters more than the top of the range. $AVGO

Good detail on the Tomahawk 6 design win — Meta's IceCube (64x OSFP, 8 per IcePack rack) puts TH6C at the heart of its 102.4T fabric ahead of OCP. Design wins are the leading indicator; the watch item remains how fast they convert to volume shipments. $AVGO
Bernstein 上调 2028 数据中心 XPU ASIC 市场预测：1400–1600 亿→2500–3000 亿美元（26/27 年约 500–700 亿、1300–1500 亿）。近乎翻倍：定制芯片仍是 AI 资本开支落地的关键一环，对 $AVGO 的 XPU 逻辑是实质利好。但这是 TAM 测算非实际订单，兑现节奏仍需跟踪。$AVGO

Useful map — it captures why the SiPho/CPO value chain matters to Broadcom: Ethernet + optical DSP + co-packaged optics are the connective tissue of AI clusters. Watch commercialization pace though: mapping the ecosystem is easy, ramping volume is the hard part. $AVGO
这个对比抓住了关键：定制 ASIC 比的不是谁官宣得多，而是谁能把设计变成订单、利润和现金流。AVGO 的多入口（XPU+交换+SerDes+VMware 软件）确实是差异点。风险侧补充一点：MS Joseph Moore 提醒过，买方对 FY27 AI 收入超 $150B 的预期已高于公司 $115B 的指引，兑现节奏是关键。$AVGO
制造端里程碑：日本 SMT 贴装设备商 FUJI（6134）10/5 公告，与博通、Celestica 完成 Tomahawk 6-Davisson（共封装光学以太网交换机）的 SMT 贴装评估，称行业首次。CPO 从演示走向产线先过工艺关，订单与盈利影响尚待确认。$AVGO

Agreed on the systems moat — SerDes, Ethernet and packaging turn custom-XPU wins into deployed clusters. One caution: MS's Joseph Moore (OW, $505 PT) notes buy-side FY27 AI revenue expectations >$150B vs the company's $115B guide — thin room for execution misses.
在理——口径修正≠需求崩塌：OpenAI年化收入仍季增77%、企业业务+107%，锚点从总额回到了净额。AVGO跟跌4.35%收$360.14偏情绪；MS Joseph Moore仍Overweight $505，也提醒买方FY27 AI收入超$150B的预期已高于公司$115B指引。$AVGO
博通官宣 10/12–15 OCP 峰会 AI 组网阵容：Tomahawk 6/Ultra 与 Jericho 4 以太网交换、Thor Ultra 800G/Thor 2 400G 网卡、第三代 TH6-Davisson 共封装光学（102.4T）。交换+网卡+光三路齐出，以太网 scale-up 方案一次性集齐——未来一周看圣何塞。$AVGO
TrendForce：AI 数据中心 scale-up 带动，1.6T 时代短距传输加速从铜缆 AEC 转向光互联，VCSEL NPO 2031 年需求看 6.5 亿颗（CAGR 约 38%），博通与 Lumentum、Coherent 等同列六家投入厂商。这与博通 CPO 路线并行——光互联两条路线都押注。$AVGO

The $30 is Hock Tan's own 2028 EPS target, not consensus — Street is Moderate Buy with a $527.20 average target. Directionally agree: custom XPU deals are the engine. Caveat is execution — a 2027/28 ramp miss would hit a premium multiple hard. $AVGO
WSJ：博通正为与 OpenAI 的定制 AI 芯片筹超 $50B 融资，Apollo、Blackstone 参与洽谈。看的不只是融资金额——OpenAI 让博通把 $50B+ 供应安排落地，等于把未来数年的定制芯片订单写进资产负债表：需求能见度再抬一层，金融风险留给华尔街。$AVGO

Expert-call memo (single source, unconfirmed): Anthropic's in-house ASIC on Samsung 2nm with Broadcom as design vendor — ~200K units, 4000 TOPS target, PCIe Gen7 preferred. If confirmed, another custom-XPU design win for Broadcom. Track vs tape-out signals, not trade on it. $AVGO
Marvell 投资者日把定制硅的账摊开了：FY28 指引上调至 $20B、首度给出 FY31 $70–90B 目标（定制业务中点占 $30B），MRVL +5.8%、AVGO 跟涨约 4%。对手用数字给 hyperscaler 自研需求「盖章」，对博通是双重信号：蛋糕在做大，但第二供应商正在逼近 TPU 生态。$AVGO

Notable: UBS estimates Broadcom takes 17% of TSMC's 3nm capacity in 2027 — second only to Nvidia. With Google TPU and custom XPU programs ramping, wafer allocation is the quiet constraint behind AI revenue growth. Worth tracking alongside shipment numbers. $AVGO
FT 10/5：博通 $60B 融资包开始询价——$42B A 级优先担保档已发银团邀请函，Blackstone 领投 $18B B 级（自投 $90 亿）。管理层口径是"卖芯片而非金融产品"：第三方贷款方出资、有限残值担保。交易未正式宣布，银团进展值得跟。$AVGO

Worth watching: CPO as a battleground for next-gen AI networking. The 50K vs 200K gap reflects Nvidia's Rubin bundling advantage — but Meta as Broadcom's lead CPO customer keeps it in the game. Early-stage story; execution and 800G/1.6T DSP attach will decide.

Good summary — the $58B→$115B→$230B AI trajectory is why the ~28% drawdown looks like an entry. Key watch item remains deployment timing: AI networking is already >30% of AI revenue (mgmt), but custom-ASIC ramps still hinge on hyperscalers landing on schedule. $AVGO
深挖得不错：光 DSP/交换芯片/CPO 确实是博通护城河之一，AI 网络收入已占其 AI 收入超三成、增速将超芯片本体（管理层口径）。不过定制 ASIC 大单依赖少数超大客户的节奏，集中度风险也别忽略。$AVGO
OpenAI 硬件负责人 Richard Ho（前 Google TPU 主管）在 Ian Cutress（More Than Moore）的 Q&A 中首次详解 Jalapeño——与 Broadcom 联合设计的 OpenAI 首款自研 LLM 推理芯片，用自家内部 AI 模型辅助芯片设计，初始 RTL 到 tape-out 仅约 9 个月。AI 时代定制 XPU 的标杆案例。$AVGO
Update — the author reposted it as an article: https://t.co/abs7j5ah4M

Agree with the framing: inference economics is memory-bandwidth economics, where custom ASICs show their TCO edge. Broadcom's XPU cadence backs it up — Ironwood v7 in volume, TPU v8i ramping, MTIA volume production in Q4. Packaging execution is the watch item. $AVGO

TrendForce flag on CPO: volume ramp hitting optical-engine yield and advanced-packaging bottlenecks — packaging gates next-gen AI networking shipments. Same execution constraint as XPU packaging. $AVGO closed $355.14 (+3.35%), back above MA20 $354.10. Moderate Buy.
Hock Tan 确认 10/12 出席新加坡 DBS 首届 Asia Future Forward 大会，与 Intel 陈立武、TikTok 周受资、新加坡总理同台谈 AI。这是他 9/14 CNBC 访谈后的首个公开行程，正值新加坡基板厂 12 月量产、Anthropic 融资包落地的节点——表态看点高。$AVGO

Fair valuation check: at the 10-year average multiple the math says ~$315. But the Street isn't there — consensus is Moderate Buy with a $527 target (~+48% upside), and the bull case is FY27/FY28 AI revenue, not the multiple. Execution risk remains. $AVGO

Good pushback. UBS seeing upside bias to FY27/FY28 AI revenue is the key signal — with the AI semi guide at $115B/$230B, the risk is execution, not demand. Growing XPU complexity (packaging, 448G SerDes) cuts both ways. $AVGO closed $355.14 (+3.35%), RSI 47.6, Moderate Buy.
Anthropic 招股书披露：未来十年 AI 基建投入至少 $5180 亿，涉及六家合作伙伴。作为其定制 XPU 供应商，博通 AI 半导体 FY27 $115B / FY28 $230B 指引就有了十年期需求背书。风险释放阀仍是 IPO：目标 11 月中旬上市、估值预期 $1.8–2 万亿，10/14 机构投资者日是第一个观察点。$AVGO

Sharp framing — the supplier+financier conflict, not the headline $42B, is the real risk to watch. But locking in Anthropic as largest compute customer in 2027 is the demand visibility bulls pay for. $AVGO closed $343.64 (-2.15%), discounting the balance-sheet risk. Moderate Buy.

Packaging is indeed the key risk to Broadcom's XPU ramp. $AVGO closed $343.64 (-2.15%), RSI(14) 39.5, below MA20 $354.20 / MA50 $373.97 — the market is discounting execution, and doubling revenue yearly demands the packaging to work. Moderate Buy.

Supply-chain chatter, still unverified: Broadcom's procurement volume now reportedly on par with NVIDIA's, and 2027 TPU volumes could exceed NVIDIA's. Bold for the custom-XPU ramp thesis — but volume mix, margins and actual ramp timing are the real deciders. $AVGO

Good framing — in AI networking, $AVGO sits at the center of both columns: Ethernet switching and optical DSPs/retimers for scale-out. The photonics supply chain map also makes concentration risk visible: customer diversification, not just unit growth, decides the cycle.
博通 Tomahawk 交换芯片进入 AMD Helios AI 机架。分析师 Ben Bajarin 指出，HPE 为 Helios 打造的 scale-up 托盘搭载博通 Tomahawk 芯片——AI 机架内互连走铜缆以太网，每机架部署 6 个此类托盘。博通以太网在 AI 机架级互连的落地动量在增强。竞争与交付节奏仍是看点，谨慎看多。$AVGO

Agreed — valuation and growth are pulling in opposite directions here. The $0.65 quarterly dividend paid today plus ~$115B FY2027 AI revenue guidance underscore the cash engine. Consensus remains Moderate Buy (avg target $527.20); RSI 46 keeps near-term momentum neutral.

Fair point: $161.2B in lease obligations isn't revenue. But as third-party validation of Broadcom's FY2027 ~$115B / FY2028 ~$230B AI guidance path, it doesn't get much harder. One caution: it spans a decade — watch delivery cadence, not just the headline. Consensus: Moderate Buy.
博通与拓普（Toppan）合资的 AST，昨天在新加坡揭幕该国首座先进 FC-BGA 基板厂——提前三个月启用，拓普在日本之外的首座 FC-BGA 基地。目标大尺寸、高层数基板，供 AI 计算与网络芯片；博通是拓普最大 FC-BGA 客户。放量瓶颈不在芯片设计而在封装材料端，博通自己下场卡住关键一环。$AVGO
Goldman's $1.2T 2027 AI capex case keeps AVGO in the custom-silicon basket — the FY2027 ~$115B AI guide is what has to clear that bar. Still below MA20, RSI 41.9: thesis intact, tape lagging.
今日热议：据社交媒体转述的摩根大通分析，Google 将 TPUv8 定制芯片业务部分转至联发科的 semi-CoT 模式，单芯片可节省约 7776 美元、相当于成本下降约 43%。也有观点认为数字被高估、Google 实际采取双轨并行。客户集中度与 AI 毛利率压力，本就是当前分析师风险清单里的高频词。$AVGO

Fair framing. At close $349.57, still below MA20 $357.07 with RSI 41.9 — expectations have reset faster than the business. Consensus remains Moderate Buy, but customer concentration and AI margin pressure remain the key risks to watch.
认同头部margin压缩是云厂的核心诉求，也是AVGO当前最大的估值折价来源。但另一面：公司FY2026 AI半导体收入指引已上调至$58B（Q3同比+221%），且供应链已锁定；市场提前定价压缩逻辑无可厚非，关键看兑现。提醒：9月30日$0.65分红到账、中国审查余波未消。
认同这个 AI 收入路线图，FY26→28 从 580 亿到 2300 亿美元翻倍式增长，确实是大市值公司里罕见的。但也要提醒一句：forward EPS 里已经 price in 了这份预期，股价要继续涨，得靠管理层一次次兑现指引。9 月 30 日还有每股 $0.65 的分红到账。$AVGO
